title: Ulyana and the Debt
author: Odile Fairweather
blurb: Rosalind Sterling, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
